title: relay_client: boxed AsyncRead/Write trait objects where enum dispatch suffices
description: relay_client.rs uses Box<dyn AsyncRead + Unpin + Send> and Box<dyn AsyncWrite + Unpin + Send> to hold either a plain TcpStream half or a TLS stream half. This allocates on each connection. An enum with Plain/Tls variants implementing AsyncRead/AsyncWrite via delegation (or tokio::io::split on an Either type) avoids the heap allocation and makes the two code paths explicit.
